/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
D={}; n=None; ss=[]
for line in Path('read.proportions.q1.fa').read_text().splitlines():
 if line.startswith('>'):
  if n:D[n]=''.join(ss)
  n=line[1:].split()[0];ss=[]
 else:ss.append(line.strip())
D[n]=''.join(ss); N=list(D); L=len(next(iter(D.values()))); rl=36
tr=str.maketrans('ACGTN','TGCAN'); rc=lambda s:s.translate(tr)[::-1]
# sets for all forward and rc windows
seqsets=defaultdict(set)
for j,nm in enumerate(N):
 s=D[nm]
 for p in range(L-rl+1):
  q=s[p:p+rl]; seqsets[q].add(j); seqsets[rc(q)].add(j)
cat=Counter(); unique=[0]*4
for j,nm in enumerate(N):
 s=D[nm]
 for p in range(L-rl+1):
  # using sequence set after all
  S=tuple(sorted(seqsets[s[p:p+rl]]))
  cat[S]+=1
  if S==(j,):unique[j]+=1
print('categories for source windows across orientations membership exact:')
print(cat)
print('unique windows',unique,'total',L-rl+1,'rates',[x/(L-rl+1) for x in unique])
# More direct distinct sequence category counts
print('distinct categories')
print(Counter(tuple(sorted(v)) for v in seqsets.values()))
PY"

from collections import defaultdict,Counter
D=defaultdict(lambda:[-999]*4); cnt=Counter(); nlines=0
with open('reads.bwa.all.sam') as f:
 for line in f:
  if line[0]=='@':continue
  a=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); rid=a[0]; r=a[2]
  if r=='*':continue
  j=int(r[-1])-1
  AS=next(int(x.split(':')[2]) for x in a[11:] if x.startswith('AS:i:'))
  if AS>D[rid][j]:D[rid][j]=AS
for vals in D.values():
 m=max(vals); w=tuple(i for i,x in enumerate(vals) if x==m)
 cnt[(m,w,tuple(x if x>-900 else None for x in vals))]+=1
# condensed winner patterns m, winners; but include values distribution
p=Counter((max(v),tuple(i for i,x in enumerate(v) if x==max(v))) for v in D.values())
print('reads with alignments',len(D))
for x,n in sorted(p.items()):print(x,n)
# per ref max count and tie unique
print('unique max',Counter(next((i for i,x in enumerate(v) if x==max(v)),None) for v in D.values() if sum(x==max(v) for x in v)==1))
print('missing per ref',Counter(sum(x is None for x in v) for v in D.values()))
PY"
